attributes.name: Mummify Self
attributes.powers: Display this card next to a character's deck. While displayed, add 1 die to her checks that invoke the Mummy trait, and reduce Poison damage dealt to her to 0; she may bury a card to add 1d6 and the Cold trait to her combat and Wisdom checks.
attributes.recovery: At the end of the scenario, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card.
